title: Versioned codecs for evaluator catalogs
summary: Evaluator codecs register as an id and a version, and an evaluator entry references its input and output codec as `inputCodec` and `outputCodec`, each an id and a version, in place of the `inputSchemaId` and `outputSchemaId` strings that carried the version; lookup is by the pair, so two versions of one codec id coexist. A catalog declares format `evaluator-catalog` with an integer `formatVersion` of 2. The legacy `ia-evaluator-catalog/1.x` shape with `name@N` codec ids is still read through an explicit legacy reader and keeps its digest, and the installed-implementation catalog in db admits both shapes. `EvaluatorCodec` gains a `version` field, so a host registering codecs adds it and drops the `@N` from the id.
